description: Two pods' documents ConfigMaps in the canonical form the Java controller writes (ConfigurationLoader.canonical) and the revision the Java loader computes for each; both loaders must agree, else a pod refuses to start on a revision mismatch.

files.Airlock-hr-assistant.yaml:
---
apiVersion: aisolate.dev/v1
kind: Airlock
metadata:
  name: hr-assistant
spec:
  space: hr-acme
  displayName: Acme HR assistant
  description: "Answers people, pay and HR document questions."
  access:
    roles:
    - employee
    callers:
    - '*'
  llms:
  - id: nomic
    provider: ollama
    url: http://host.minikube.internal:11434
    model: nomic-embed-text:v1.5
  dataSources:
  - id: hr-documents
    url: jdbc:postgresql://acme-db.aisolate.svc:5432/acme_hr
    secretRef: hr-acme-hr-assistant-ds-hr-documents-d4e5f6
files.AirlockVersion-hr-assistant-v1.yaml:
---
apiVersion: aisolate.dev/v1
kind: AirlockVersion
metadata:
  name: hr-assistant-v1
spec:
  airlock: hr-assistant
  version: v1
  description: "Pay from the tools, policies from the HR documents."
  preLLM:
    contextPreparator:
      handlers:
      - HrDocumentsContextPreparator
    conversationMemory:
      handlers:
      - SessionMemory
  llm: granite
  prompt: |
    You are the Acme HR assistant. All amounts are in EUR.
  tools:
  - read_records
  - aggregate_records
  postLLM:
    answerVerifier:
      handlers:
      - SalaryVerifier
  llms: []
  jar:
    digest: sha256:784c6018d0c0bb8d5ca5bf7e112fddd4a7f6df85f8517b1669c75e7b159aa24f
    tools:
    - read_records
    - aggregate_records
